The software displays the results of the sample. The top value (in large font) is the concentration of the original sample. The bottom value is the dilution concentration. Record the concentration of the original sample, remove the tube and repeat readings and results recording for each additional sample.

steps.title: Label and arrange tubes
steps.instruction: Set up the required number of Qubit tubes for standards and samples, label the tube lids (not the sides) as S1 and S2 for the two standards.

steps.title: Prepare working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the Qubit dsDNA Reagent in Buffer at a 1:200 ratio to make the working solution; optionally add extra volume for overage.

steps.title: Add working solution to standards
steps.instruction: Pipette 190 µL of the working solution into each standard tube (S1 and S2).

steps.title: Add standards to tubes
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of standard #1 to tube S1 and 10 µL of standard #2 to tube S2, then vortex each tube to mix.

steps.title: Add working solution to samples
steps.instruction: Add 198 µL of the working solution to each sample tube.

steps.title: Add samples to tubes
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of each DNA sample to its corresponding tube, vortex to mix; final volume in each tube should be 200 µL.

steps.title: Incubate tubes
steps.instruction: Allow all tubes (standards and samples) to incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Optional reagent calculator (4.0)
steps.instruction: On a Qubit 4.0, open the on‑board Reagent Calculator, enter the total number of standards and samples (include overage if desired), and press Done to return to the Home screen.

steps.title: Select assay on instrument
steps.instruction: On the Qubit home screen, press dsDNA and choose either dsDNA: High Sensitivity or dsDNA: Broad Range according to the kit used.

steps.title: Calibrate with standards (if needed)
steps.instruction: If performing calibration, press Read Standards, then: (a) insert Standard #1 tube, close lid, press Read Standard, remove tube; (b) insert Standard #2 tube, close lid, press Read Standard, remove tube. The instrument will display calibration results.

substeps.instruction: Insert Standard #1, close lid, press Read Standard, remove tube.
Insert Standard #2, close lid, press Read Standard, remove tube.

steps.title: Read sample tubes
steps.instruction: Press Read Samples, set the Sample Volume screen to the volume of sample added (2 µL) and choose output units (ng/µL), then for each sample: insert the tube, close lid, press Read Tube.
